title: Wakebenders Boat Rental
specs: Luxury fleet including surf boats and pontoons
Located on Lake Okanagan in Kelowna with downtown launch
Applicants for Elite Membership must apply jointly with a co-member of their own choosing
Memberships can be split with up to two other individuals who are frequent guests or work separate shifts
Corporate retreats can be planned with multiple boats for groups and breakout sessions
includes: Boat prep, safety checks, docking help, and post-trip cleanup
blurb: Guests can enjoy luxury boat memberships with unlimited boating access, valet boat storage, and curated boat charters for corporate retreats and special occasions like anniversaries. The club offers a concierge service, a fleet of surf boats and pontoons, and options for captained experiences. Services include boat prep, safety briefings, and post-trip cleanup, with a focus on hassle-free luxury boating.
extraNote: Fuel cost is additional to membership fees · Early booking recommended for September retreats and prime sunset hours · No matching or pairing of unrelated individuals for membership sharing · Water Street Boat Launch, Downtown Kelowna
